brands.evidence: Yes, absolutely. Monzo is a fully licensed UK bank, and millions of people use it as their primary bank account

client_claims.text: Monzo is a fully licensed UK bank
client_claims.note: Consistent with PRA authorisation and FCA/PRA regulation.

client_claims.text: Eligible deposits are protected up to £85,000 per person by the FSCS
client_claims.note: Fact states the FSCS limit is £120,000 per person, not £85,000.

client_claims.text: millions of people use it as their primary bank account
client_claims.note: Facts give 15.2m customers and 10.4m monthly active, but nothing on primary account use.

client_claims.text: Monzo lets you claim your salary at 4:00 PM on the working day before it would normally land
client_claims.note: Get Paid Early timing is not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: Monzo allows cash deposits via PayPoint and the Post Office, with a £1 per deposit fee on the free standard plan
client_claims.note: Cash deposit fees are not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: Monzo participates in the Current Account Switch Service 7-day switch guarantee
client_claims.note: CASS participation is not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: Monzo offers joint accounts, arranged overdrafts, and credit cards (Monzo Flex)
Monzo has no physical branches; customer service is via the app or telephone support
